label: Avs V system
definition: An AVAST system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded subtype V locus represented by DefenseFinder with an Avs5A profile.
observations: Avs subtype V branch under AVAST system; distinct from the broader AVAST system, the individual Avs5A protein, the individual DefenseFinder Avs_V profile row, unresolved Avs V effector chemistry, Avs I through Avs IV subtypes, jumbo-phage-specific Avs5 immunity outside the named subsystem, and other phage-defense systems.
